full_judgment:
This Rule is at the instance of the pre-emptor. It calls in question the propriety of the judgment and order dated 13-12-78 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Rangpur in Misc. Appeal 80 of 1978 allowing the appeal, refusing pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act by reversing the judgment and order dated 10-6-1978 passed by Munsif, 1st Court, Rangpur in Misc. Case 369 or 1975 allowing preemption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 

 "3(a) an application made under sub-section (1) shall be dismissed unless the applicant or applicants, at the time of making it, deposit in the court the amount of consideration money or the value of the transferred holding or portion of share of the holding as stated in the notice under section 89 or in the deed of transfer, as the case may be, together with compensation at the rate of ten per centum of such amount. "
